skills.desc: Quieter movement. Zombies hear you less.

skills.desc: Damage and swing speed with blunt weapons.

skills.name: Blade
skills.desc: Damage and swing speed with bladed weapons.

skills.name: Carpentry
skills.desc: Unlocks builds, stronger structures, faster building.

skills.name: Engineering
skills.desc: Machines, electricity, metalwork. Higher levels speed up the factory.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.desc: Faster, more effective treatment and healing.

skills.name: Scavenging
skills.desc: Find more loot and search faster.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Better meals: more nourishment, less spoilage risk, faster cooking.

skills.name: Farming
skills.desc: Crops grow faster and yield more.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.desc: Find more berries, mushrooms and herbs; spot poisonous ones.

traits.name: Thick Skinned
traits.desc: Scratches and bites are less likely to break skin.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: Wider awareness: zombies show on the compass sooner.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.desc: Need less sleep. Better night vision.

traits.name: Iron Gut
traits.desc: Much less likely to get food poisoning.

traits.name: Hemophobic
traits.desc: Panic when bleeding or covered in blood. Slow at first aid.

occupations.desc: No skills, lots of potential (+8 trait points).

occupations.desc: Firearms +3, Fitness +1. Starts with a pistol and ammo.

occupations.name: Nurse
occupations.desc: First Aid +3, Lightfooted +1. Starts with medical supplies.

occupations.name: Electrical Engineer
occupations.desc: Engineering +3, Carpentry +1. The factory dreamer. Starts with a screwdriver & wrench.

occupations.name: Lumberjack
occupations.desc: Blade +2, Strength +1, Fitness +1. Starts with an axe.

occupations.name: Burglar

occupations.name: Veteran
occupations.desc: Firearms +2, Blunt +1, Fitness +1. Calm under pressure (less panic).
